title: Message the group
recap: Pipo sent the plan to the Climate group.
funFact: Agents can write polite emails, too. Next, Pipo asks your professor for more time!
postcard: four phones lighting up in a lecture hall with Pipo's message: {message}
situation: The plan's ready! Shall I send it to your group chat?
facts: 📋 Priya research, Tom script, Lee slides, you speaking notes
👀 You want to check before it's sent
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on a university student's phone. You can send WhatsApp messages for them. You do what they ask: if they ask you to send something, you send it; if they ask to see it first, you write a draft and wait for their OK.

tools.name: send_whatsapp_message
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp message right away. Use this when the user wants it sent.

to.description: Who gets the message: a contact, a group chat, or all contacts

message.description: The message text, up to 30 words

tools.name: draft_whatsapp_message
tools.description: Write the WhatsApp message and show it to the user without sending it, so they can check it first. Use this when the user wants to see it before it goes out.

to.description: Who gets the message: a contact, a group chat, or all contacts

message.description: The message text, up to 30 words

lines.text: Draft ready, waiting for your OK to send

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Send the plan to the Climate group chat
pieces.text: Send our plan to the "Climate group" WhatsApp chat.

pieces.label: Who does what
pieces.text: Say who does what: Priya research, Tom the script, Lee the slides, and me the speaking notes.

pieces.label: Meet Wednesday 6pm at the library
pieces.text: Say we'll meet on Wednesday at 6pm at the library.

pieces.label: Just say 'let's do this!!!'
pieces.tip: Hype is fun, but nobody knows what to do next. Put the actual plan in the message.

pieces.label: Show me the message first
pieces.text: Show me the message before you send it.

flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know which chat, so it didn't go to the Climate group.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo who does what.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't have the jobs, so the message doesn't say who does what.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when you're meeting.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know about Wednesday, so nobody knows when to meet.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the message first lets you fix it before the group reads it.
flaws.explain: Pipo sent it straight away, so you never got to check it.

lesson: Put the real details in the message: who does what, and when you meet.
